name: heyzine-plugin
description: Standalone single-plugin marketplace for the Heyzine plugin - publish PDFs as flipbooks and carry them to lead magnets, LearnDash course material, website embeds, bookshelves and access lists.

plugins.name: heyzine
plugins.description: Publish PDFs as Heyzine flipbooks and carry them to lead magnets, LearnDash course material, website embeds and bookshelves. Activates for: (1) converting a PDF, Word or PowerPoint file into a flipbook, (2) listing, inspecting, restyling, replacing or deleting flipbooks, (3) building a lead magnet share kit with embed code and short link, (4) adding course PDFs to LearnDash Materials, (5) filling and ordering Heyzine bookshelves, (6) password and per-user access lists, (7) reconciling a list of resource names against the account.
